concept_attempts.feedback: Selected: broad low mineral mound, darker left cleft, pale front/right knuckles and a compact reddish copper crown with a shallow central depression. Fine ore facets, exact depression profile and hidden sections remain authored; no mechanical/charging operation added.

glb_feedback.stage: Complete actual native/import pass and original/concept/GLB comparison.
discrepancies: Voxel-rounded body reads as smooth blobs instead of fractured ore knuckles.
Uniform glossy elliptical cleft looks like an added port, not a natural recess.
Copper cap has a puffy, pinched centre rather than a flatter shallow depression.
corrections: Union faceted ore lobes while preserving larger natural planes, subtle bevels and pale exposed regions.
Use a shallower irregular cut and rough dark-green mineral interior.
Flatten cap shoulders/floor, remove displacement at central depression, add gentle authored copper micro-normal.

glb_feedback.stage: Second complete native/import pass after topology repair.
glb_feedback.finding: Large low-resolution lobe planes, flat-face normal weighting and regional per-polygon material changes read as low-poly triangles. Cap is still too bulbous.
glb_feedback.correction: Use denser ore lobe geometry and modest fine relief, mostly smooth normals, reserve pale material for actual wear cuts, flatten copper shoulder profile. Keep strict native/import topology and image checks.

glb_feedback.finding: Polar UV convergence makes a star-like copper highlight/colour pattern despite a flat depression floor. Ore albedo/roughness variation is too quiet for the worn metallic source/concept.
glb_feedback.correction: Planar copper UVs remove the polar singularity, keep true depression geometry. Stronger continuous pale wear regions and roughness variation in the authored ore map, no per-polygon panels.

final_review: Actual independent GLB retains the low connected ore mound, dark left cleft, paler front/right knuckles and compact rear-left reddish copper crown. The shallow crown depression is geometry and its bottom is seated in the mineral body. Native/import surfaces, closed meshes and portable texture pixels are compared; no unsupported operating clip is introduced.
limitations: Exact ore facets, hidden sections, cap depression and mental-energy engineering remain authored or unknown.
Generic ST11 high-energy stores are research function context, not Mikotaj geometry or a charging operation.
Final user artistic acceptance, client scale/state/shaders and Android performance remain separate.
